chunk_text: Clothing items such as shirts, dresses, trousers and ethnic wear can be returned within 15 days of delivery.
The item must be unworn, unwashed, and returned with its original tags and packaging intact.
Innerwear, socks, and any apparel explicitly marked "non-returnable" on the product page are excluded from this window.
Shoes, sandals and sneakers can be returned within 12 days of delivery, provided the sole shows no signs of outdoor wear.
The original shoebox must be returned alongside the product, since a damaged or missing shoebox reduces resale value and may result in a partial refund.
Customised or made-to-order footwear is not eligible for return.
Electronics such as mobile phones, laptops, headphones and smart watches can be returned within 10 days of delivery.
All original accessories, chargers, manuals and the outer box must be included for the return to be accepted.
Activated SIM-based devices are subject to an additional deactivation check before the refund is approved.
Home and kitchen products such as cookware, bedsheets, curtains and small storage items can be returned within 10 days of delivery.
Items must be unused and in their original packaging, since hygiene and safety checks apply to anything that contacts food or bedding.
Assembled furniture is handled under a separate large-item return process and is not covered by this window.

document_title: Beauty and Personal Care Return Window
chunk_text: Beauty and personal care items can be returned within 7 days of delivery only if the factory seal is unbroken.

document_title: Beauty and Personal Care Return Window
chunk_text: Once a seal is opened, the product cannot be resold for hygiene reasons and becomes non-returnable, though a replacement may still be issued for a genuinely defective unit.

document_title: Beauty and Personal Care Return Window
chunk_text: Gift sets are treated as a single unit and cannot be partially returned.
For orders paid by cash on delivery, refunds are issued to the customer's bank account or Flipkart wallet rather than reversed to a card.
The refund is initiated within 2 business days after the returned item passes quality inspection, and bank transfers typically settle within 5-7 additional business days.
Wallet refunds are usually instant once the return is approved.
For orders paid by card, UPI or net banking, the refund is reversed to the original payment method within 2 business days of the return passing quality inspection.
Card refunds may take a further 5-9 business days to reflect on the statement depending on the issuing bank, while UPI and net-banking refunds usually settle within 2-4 business days.
Standard delivery to a metro address is estimated at 2-4 business days from dispatch, and 5-8 business days for non-metro or remote pin codes.
The exact estimate shown at checkout accounts for the seller's dispatch location, the destination pin code, and current courier load.
Express delivery, where available, is estimated at 1-2 business days for an additional fee.
If a shipment has not moved for more than 2 days past its estimated delivery date, the order is flagged as delayed and the customer can request a status update or cancellation without penalty.
A delayed order that is subsequently cancelled receives a full refund regardless of the payment method used.
Repeated delays on the same shipment are escalated internally to the logistics partner.
Reverse pickup, where a courier collects the item from the customer's address, is available for most pin codes covered by Flipkart's own logistics network.
In pin codes without reverse pickup coverage, the customer must self-ship the item to the address provided in the return instructions, and shipping cost is reimbursed on approval of the return.
Once a return is approved, a pickup is scheduled within 1-2 business days and the courier makes up to 2 attempts before the return is marked failed.

The collected item reaches the quality-inspection facility within 3-5 business days of pickup, and the refund clock described in the payment-specific refund policies only starts once that inspection passes.
A product that arrives visibly damaged or crushed must be reported within 48 hours of delivery through the order's "Report an issue" option.
Photographic evidence of the damage and the packaging speeds up approval, and a damaged-on-arrival claim skips the standard return window restrictions since the fault is not the customer's.
If the item received does not match what was ordered, the customer should report it within 3 days of delivery rather than filing a routine return.

A wrong-item claim is prioritised over standard returns, does not count against the product's normal return window, and typically results in either a free replacement or a full refund at the customer's choice.

An order can be cancelled free of charge any time before it is marked "shipped." Once a courier has picked up the package, the order can no longer be cancelled and must instead go through the standard return process after delivery.
Prepaid orders cancelled before shipping are refunded in full within 2 business days.
Apparel and footwear can be exchanged for a different size of the same product within the category's normal return window, subject to stock availability at the time of the request.

An exchange does not generate a refund; instead the replacement ships once the original item is picked up, and if the requested size is unavailable the request automatically converts to a standard refund.
Certain categories are marked non-returnable at the time of purchase, including innerwear, opened beauty products, perishable goods, and software or digital gift cards.
These items are clearly labelled "non-returnable" on the product page before checkout, and only a genuine manufacturing defect qualifies them for a replacement rather than a standard return.
